author: Ryan Daws
description:
Google has officially renamed its open-source ZetaSQL project to GoogleSQL. The update unifies the branding for the SQL dialect, analysis, and parsing libraries used across Google’s internal services, cloud platforms, and the external developer community. title: Google rebrands open-source ZetaSQL project to GoogleSQL
